title: What Lies Beyond Perception: A Partition Theory of the Limits of AI Evaluation and Oversight
abstract: arXiv:2610.30803v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Replacing the judge can move a benchmark score, and models can be trained to hide capabilities. Both put the evaluator in question: what can it certify? We develop a partition theory of evaluation from one principle: judgement is bounded by perception. An agent's discrimination is the partition of its inputs into classes it cannot tell apart. Discrimination is necessary for capability but not sufficient, so bounds on it bear directly on whether evaluation can show that a model lacks an ability. We prove a one-sided bound. An examinee whose partition refines its evaluator's has the discrimination to pass every test the evaluator can grade, provided each input has an acceptable reply. We define the echo test, which accepts any reply the evaluator perceives as identical to the input, and show that it is complete for the tests the evaluator can grade. Passing therefore certifies at most a floor on discrimination, never a ceiling, and only

translated_title: 《超越感知的边界：AI评估与监督局限性的划分理论》
translated_abstract: 更换评判者可以改变基准测试的得分，而模型也可以通过训练学会隐藏自身能力。这两者都使评估者本身受到质疑：它究竟可以认证什么？我们从一个原则出发，建立了一套评估的划分理论：判断能力受感知能力所限。智能体的“辨别力”是指将其输入划分为它无法相互区分的类别所形成的一种划分。辨别力是能力的必要条件但非充分条件，因此对辨别力的界限直接关系到评估能否证明某个模型不具备某种能力。我们证明了一个单侧界限：只要每个输入都存在一个可接受的回应，那么当应试者的划分比评估者的划分更精细时，该应试者就具备通过评估者所能评定的所有测试所需的辨别力。我们定义了“回声测试”，该测试接受任何被评估者感知为与输入相同的回应，并证明它对于评估者所能评定的测试是完备的。因此，通过测试最多只能认证辨别力的下限，而永远无法认证其上限……
tldr: 本文提出AI评估的划分理论，证明当被评估模型的感知划分比评估者更精细时，通过评估者所能评定的任何测试都最多只能认证模型辨别力的下限而非上限，从而揭示了AI评估与监督存在的根本性局限。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a partition theory of AI evaluation showing that when an examinee's discrimination is finer than its evaluator's, passing any test the evaluator can grade certifies at most a floor—never a ceiling—on the model's discrimination, revealing fundamental limits of AI evaluation and oversight.
